# Slay Clay

Slay Clay is a handmade brand creating small customizable clay objects and accessories.

## Primary purpose
Visitors can discover creations, browse product categories, and submit a custom request.

## Custom requests
The site collects a product category, name, reference image preview, and idea in the browser. Requests are handed off to WhatsApp with a prefilled text message. Static GitHub Pages cannot directly attach a local browser file to WhatsApp; the visitor is instructed to attach the reference image in the WhatsApp chat.

## Brand style
Soft lavender and purple, cute handmade illustration, subtle paper texture, glossy tactile clay, soft dreamy slightly retro mood.

## Contact
WhatsApp: supplied separately by the site owner.
Instagram: supplied separately by the site owner.
